verdict.rationale: The docs contain static code snippets (e.g. supermemory-docs-24, -27) and an 'API reference overview' page (supermemory-docs-26) listing client libraries, but there is no evidence of an interactive, runnable API explorer (e.g. Swagger/Redoc 'try it' UI).
